name: PURGE folder lifecycle — archival staging (no deletion)
description: Monthly sweep (or on operator command "purge legacy files") moves every *_LEGACY_* file/folder older than 30 days into ~/Desktop/_PURGE/YYYYMMDD/. _PURGE/ is permanent cold storage — nothing is ever deleted from it (operator directive: archive, never destroy). Sweep does not run automatically — operator must invoke. Auto-sweeps risk losing files the operator intended to reference.

protocol.action: find files matching *_LEGACY_* across operator's typical project roots
print count + total size + oldest/newest mtime + sample paths
show contents of new _PURGE/YYYYMMDD/ subfolder after move

why_medium: LEGACY files accumulate in the active tree otherwise. Two-step lifecycle (rollout archival → 30-day move to _PURGE cold storage) keeps the active workspace tidy. Archive is terminal — nothing is ever deleted; disk is abundant, so there is no deletion step. (The former "60-day rm -rf" stage was struck 2026-07-08 per operator directive: archive, never destroy.)
